minor.issue: Pre-existing validation gap (NOT a regression from refactor — same behavior in original server.py). The check `if not corp_email or '@' not in corp_email` accepts malformed inputs like `@missinglocal.com` (empty local-part) as valid. Suggest tightening to a regex or Pydantic EmailStr. Low priority since the free-domain guard still blocks the common cases and downstream SendGrid would reject it anyway.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Tighten `_email_domain`/local-part validation in routes/players_corp_email.py to reject `@domain.com` (empty local-part). Pre-existing gap, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/players_corp_email.py — clean extraction. `register(api, db, deps)` pattern isolates the module; only uses `deps.get_current_user` from server.py. FREE_EMAIL_DOMAINS as frozenset (immutable, fast lookup) is a nice touch. Full type hints (`Any`, `Optional[dict]`, `frozenset[str]`) pass mypy strict.

server.py line 1843 — kept `_email_domain` helper for /api/players/profiles use (verified referenced at ~line 1906 via `own_domain = _email_domain(user.get('email') or '')`). Refactor comment at line 1840-1842 clearly documents the split rationale. Good.

server.py line 5090-5095 — registration wired via SimpleNamespace deps. Import inside body is fine (late binding avoids circular). `noqa: E402` accepted since the file's late-import pattern is consistent with sitemap/CS modules.
email_service.py line 71 — `return bool(ok)` cast is a no-op behavior-wise (ok is already bool) but silences mypy no-any-return since resp.status_code type is Any. Correct fix.

mypy.ini — per-module `[mypy-routes.X]` sections with `check_untyped_defs = True` is scoped correctly; won't force strictness on the large legacy server.py. `ignore_missing_imports = True` global is pragmatic for 3rd-party stubs. `warn_unused_ignores = False` is a bit generous — consider tightening after full refactor.
scripts/lint_types.sh — clean bash: `set -euo pipefail`, `cd $(dirname $0)/..` for CWD safety, `--all` toggle for full-repo check, exec pattern to save a subprocess. Executable bit set (verified).
